title: The Tractor on the Farm | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Join the red tractor as it wakes up at sunrise and ploughs the fields, then gets stuck in the mud and needs everyone to push together!
A sweet song about teamwork, helping each other, and how the crops grow.
Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers learning sounds, actions and counting along.

Wake up, wake up, the sun is rising
Tractor says "vroom, vroom, vroom"
Brrr, brrr, brrr, the engine hums
Red tractor, let's go!
Vroom vroom, tractor, let's plough the field
Up and down in rows
Rumble, rumble, rumble, go
Plough, plough, plough, the crops must grow!
Splish, splat, the wheel gets stuck
Deep in the mud it sinks
Stuck, stuck, stuck, stuck
Oh no, oh no, what now?
Vroom vroom, tractor, let's plough the field
Up and down in rows
Rumble, rumble, rumble, go
Plough, plough, plough, the crops must grow!
Little sister, big brother, come and push
Farmer uncle, heave ho!
Push, push, push, push
Out it comes, hooray, hooray!
Vroom vroom, tractor, let's plough the field
Up and down in rows
Rumble, rumble, rumble, go
Plough, plough, plough, the crops must grow!
Amma calls, "the rice is cooked!"
Green fields sway, sway, sway
Grow, grow, grow, grow
Thank you, farmer, thank you all!
